frontmatter.title: Bridging the Gap: Packaging Python for AWS Lambda with Debian-Based Containers
frontmatter.subheading: Why your Python build works on Debian but fails on Amazon Linux 2 - and how to fix it
frontmatter.excerpt: Discover why using Debian-based containers to build Python AWS Lambda packages causes runtime issues and how to properly compile dependencies for Amazon Linux 2 compatibility using platform flags or Amazon-based containers.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
